description: Internal rate of return of a series of cash flows, per period, with the equity multiple and every rate that sets the net present value to zero. IRR is where calculators silently disagree: a series with no sign change has no IRR at all, and one that changes sign more than once can have several; this engine refuses the first with a named reason and lists every root of the second. Send cash_flows as comma-separated numbers, period 0 first, with money put in as negative numbers, for example -100000,8000,8500,9000,9500,130000. Yearly flows give a yearly IRR.

cash_flows.description: Comma-separated cash flows, period 0 first, e.g. -100000,8000,8500,9000,9500,130000
